name: sakura-bloom
description: Authentic Cherry Blossom (Sakura) chromatic design package for nocturnal and daytime hanami editorial experiences.
referenceWorld: Japanese cherry blossom arboretum, traditional hanami under evening lanterns (Yozakura), polished hinoki wood, stone paths, and seasonal Kyoto wagashi.
antiPatterns: Reject synthetic hyper-neon magenta, abrasive un-shaded pink, blinding white cards, low-contrast washed-out pastel text, and arbitrary decorative gradients.
materiality: Tactile, organic surfaces blending deep night ink (#120b10) with translucent rose-quartz slate panels, soft cherry bark borders, and delicate Sakura petal highlights.
density: Quiet, deliberate spatial pacing honoring Japanese Ma (negative space). 60% nocturnal garden substrate, 30% structured blossom panels, and 10% focal floral accents.
motionGrammar: Delicate, natural flutter physics inspired by falling petals in light wind. 220ms ease-out transitions for cards and menus; strict prefers-reduced-motion zero-drift guarantee.
interactionPhysics: Crisp, tactile responsiveness on all interactive cards, season schedule toggles, pass tiers, and lantern illumination states. Direct feedback without speculative bounce.
informationHierarchy: Bloom phase & cultivar identification first (Somei Yoshino, Kanzan, Shirofugen), followed by timeline schedule, stage frequency details, garden navigation, and reservation ticketing.
responsiveBehavior: Container-proportional layout stacking gracefully from multi-column garden exhibits into single-column mobile viewports (down to 320px) while maintaining 44px touch targets.
accessibility: High-contrast legibility across both Yozakura (night) and Daytime Hanami themes. Meets WCAG AAA with primary text contrast over 14:1 and UI accents exceeding 4.5:1.
brandVoice: Serene, poetic, botanically accurate, and technologically refined. Balances Japanese seasonal terminology (Yozakura, Hanami, Ma) with clear recovery instructions.
iconography: Minimalist, organic line iconography reflecting flora, lanterns, seasonal tea, acoustic strings, and pathfinding.
dataViz: Bloom tracking charts, cultivar flowering phase indicators, countdown timers, and capacity allocation meters with readable monospace numbers.
stateGrammar: Distinct default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, bloom-in-progress, peak-bloom, and verified pass states.
provenance: Calibrated against Skill 31 (NouGenMorph Color Theory & Chromatic Web Architecture) and authentic Japanese botanical color records for Prunus serrulata cultivars.

tokens.--font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
